mapper.select: SELECT A.ptcp_inst_sn AS ptcpInstSn , A.pblnt_sn AS pblntSn , A.inst_id AS instId , A.brno AS brno , A.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd AS uldInstPrgrsSttsStcd , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_dmnd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpDmndDt , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_cfmtn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpCfmtnDt , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_rtrcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpRtrcnDt , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpRegDt , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_cmptn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpCmptnDt , TO_CHAR(A.ptcp_rdmnd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ptcpRdmndDt , A.uld_type_cd AS uldTypeCd , TO_CHAR(A.uld_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS uldDt , A.ver_info_nm AS verInfoNm , A.last_updt_ymd AS lastUpdtYmd , A.updt_cycle_cnt AS updtCycleCnt , A.del_yn AS delYn , A.rgtr_id AS rgtrId , TO_CHAR(A.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , TO_CHAR(A.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mdfcnDt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst A WHERE A.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND A.pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND (A.del_yn IS NULL OR A.del_yn = 'N') /* 동일 키 중복 시: 내용이 채워진 행 우선(재등록요청 등으로 최신 행만 비어 있는 경우 방지) */ ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(A.ver_info_nm, '')), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, A.mdfcn_dt DESC NULLS LAST, A.reg_dt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst ( ptcp_inst_sn, pblnt_sn, uld_type_cd, uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, ptcp_cmptn_dt, ver_info_nm, last_updt_ymd, updt_cycle_cnt, del_yn, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( #{ptcpInstSn}, #{pblntSn}, '02', '02', NULL, #{verInfoNm}, #{lastUpdtYmd}, #{updtCycleCnt}, COALESCE(#{delYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자'), NOW(), COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자'), NOW() )

INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst ( ptcp_inst_sn, pblnt_sn, uld_type_cd, uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, ptcp_cmptn_dt, ver_info_nm, last_updt_ymd, updt_cycle_cnt, del_yn, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( #{ptcpInstSn}, #{pblntSn}, '02', '03', NOW(), #{verInfoNm}, #{lastUpdtYmd}, #{updtCycleCnt}, COALESCE(#{delYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자'), NOW(), COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자'), NOW() )
